//@version=6
indicator("Orora Daily Trade Study - Oct 12 2026", overlay=true, max_labels_count=80)
// Supplied October 12 trading levels and signal rules.
showLabels = input.bool(true, "Show small level labels")
showReferences = input.bool(true, "Show PDH and PDL reference")
requireVolume = input.bool(true, "Require 1.3x prior 20-bar volume")
morningOnly = input.bool(true, "Only 09:30-12:00 New York signals")
string nyTZ = "America/New_York"
float le = na
float ls = na
float lt1 = na
float lt2 = na
float se = na
float ss = na
float st1 = na
float st2 = na
string symbolName = "NOT IN WATCHLIST"

if syminfo.ticker == "CRM"
    le := 239.75
    ls := 236.25
    lt1 := 244.25
    lt2 := 248.5
    se := 234.95
    ss := 238.05
    st1 := 231
    st2 := 226.7
    symbolName := "CRM"

if syminfo.ticker == "IREN"
    le := 37.2
    ls := 35.95
    lt1 := 38.65
    lt2 := 40.2
    se := 35.45
    ss := 36.75
    st1 := 34
    st2 := 32.4
    symbolName := "IREN"

if syminfo.ticker == "MU"
    le := 1021
    ls := 1007
    lt1 := 1039
    lt2 := 1057
    se := 998
    ss := 1013
    st1 := 979
    st2 := 959
    symbolName := "MU"

if syminfo.ticker == "TMUS"
    le := 152
    ls := 149.45
    lt1 := 155.05
    lt2 := 158.15
    se := 146.85
    ss := 149.25
    st1 := 143.75
    st2 := 140.75
    symbolName := "TMUS"

if syminfo.ticker == "URBN"
    le := 77.35
    ls := 75.45
    lt1 := 80
    lt2 := 82.25
    se := 74.15
    ss := 76
    st1 := 71.7
    st2 := 69.25
    symbolName := "URBN"

if syminfo.ticker == "HUM"
    le := 440.5
    ls := 433.5
    lt1 := 449.5
    lt2 := 459
    se := 427.6
    ss := 434
    st1 := 419
    st2 := 409
    symbolName := "HUM"

if syminfo.ticker == "CCI"
    le := 80.5
    ls := 78.9
    lt1 := 82.45
    lt2 := 84.5
    se := 77.35
    ss := 79
    st1 := 75.25
    st2 := 73.2
    symbolName := "CCI"

if syminfo.ticker == "AMD"
    le := 610.5
    ls := 603.5
    lt1 := 620
    lt2 := 629
    se := 598.5
    ss := 606.2
    st1 := 589
    st2 := 579
    symbolName := "AMD"

if syminfo.ticker == "NVDA"
    le := 232.3
    ls := 229.6
    lt1 := 235.6
    lt2 := 239
    se := 227.9
    ss := 230.2
    st1 := 225.05
    st2 := 222.05
    symbolName := "NVDA"

if syminfo.ticker == "XOM"
    le := 171.5
    ls := 169.85
    lt1 := 173.55
    lt2 := 175.65
    se := 168.8
    ss := 170.4
    st1 := 166.8
    st2 := 164.65
    symbolName := "XOM"

plot(le, "LONG ABOVE", color=color.lime, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(ls, "LONG STOP", color=color.orange, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(lt1, "LONG TARGET 1", color=color.aqua, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(lt2, "LONG TARGET 2", color=color.blue, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(se, "SHORT BELOW", color=color.red, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(ss, "SHORT STOP", color=color.fuchsia, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(st1, "SHORT TARGET 1", color=color.purple, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(st2, "SHORT TARGET 2", color=color.maroon, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

int nyDayKey = year(time, nyTZ) * 10000 + month(time, nyTZ) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, nyTZ)
bool inRth = not na(time(timeframe.period, "0930-1600:1234567", nyTZ))
bool newRth = inRth and (not inRth[1] or nyDayKey != nyDayKey[1])
var float runningPV = 0.0
var float runningVolume = 0.0
if newRth
    runningPV := 0.0
    runningVolume := 0.0
if inRth
    runningPV += hlc3 * volume
    runningVolume += volume
float rthVWAP = inRth and runningVolume > 0 ? runningPV / runningVolume : na
plot(rthVWAP, "RTH VWAP", color=color.yellow, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
float pdh = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", high[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
float pdl = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", low[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
bool correctDate = nyDayKey == 20261012
bool morningRth = not na(time(timeframe.period, "0930-1200:1234567", nyTZ))
float average20PriorVolume = ta.sma(volume, 20)[1]
bool volumeOK = not requireVolume or (not na(average20PriorVolume) and volume >= 1.3 * average20PriorVolume)
bool timeOK = timeframe.isintraday and correctDate and inRth and (not morningOnly or morningRth)
bool crossedLong = ta.crossover(close, le)
bool crossedShort = ta.crossunder(close, se)
bool longSignal = barstate.isconfirmed and timeOK and not na(le) and crossedLong and not na(rthVWAP) and close > rthVWAP and volumeOK
bool shortSignal = barstate.isconfirmed and timeOK and not na(se) and crossedShort and not na(rthVWAP) and close < rthVWAP and volumeOK
plotshape(longSignal, title="LONG signal", text="LONG", style=shape.labelup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(shortSignal, title="SHORT signal", text="SHORT", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)

plot(showReferences ? pdh : na, "PDH Reference", color=color.new(color.gray, 50), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showReferences ? pdl : na, "PDL Reference", color=color.new(color.gray, 50), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
alertcondition(longSignal, title="LONG ABOVE + VWAP", message="{{ticker}} LONG breakout confirmed at {{close}} with RTH VWAP, Oct 12 study. Verify option quotes.")
alertcondition(shortSignal, title="SHORT BELOW + VWAP", message="{{ticker}} SHORT breakdown confirmed at {{close}} with RTH VWAP, Oct 12 study. Verify option quotes.")
f_display(float v) => na(v) ? "N/A" : str.tostring(v, format.mintick)
var array<label> levelLabels = array.new<label>()
if barstate.islast
    if array.size(levelLabels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(levelLabels) - 1
            label.delete(array.get(levelLabels, i))
        array.clear(levelLabels)
    if showLabels and not na(le)
        array.push(levelLabels, label.new(bar_index + 2, le, "LONG > " + f_display(le), color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny))
        array.push(levelLabels, label.new(bar_index + 2, ls, "L STOP " + f_display(ls), color=color.orange, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny))
        array.push(levelLabels, label.new(bar_index + 2, lt1, "L T1 " + f_display(lt1), color=color.teal, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny))
        array.push(levelLabels, label.new(bar_index + 2, lt2, "L T2 " + f_display(lt2), color=color.blue, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny))
        array.push(levelLabels, label.new(bar_index + 2, se, "SHORT < " + f_display(se), color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny))
        array.push(levelLabels, label.new(bar_index + 2, ss, "S STOP " + f_display(ss), color=color.fuchsia, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny))
        array.push(levelLabels, label.new(bar_index + 2, st1, "S T1 " + f_display(st1), color=color.purple, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny))
        array.push(levelLabels, label.new(bar_index + 2, st2, "S T2 " + f_display(st2), color=color.maroon, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_left, size=size.tiny))

var table dash = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 12, frame_color=color.new(color.gray, 50), border_width=1)
if barstate.islast
    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, "OCT 12 TRADE LEVELS", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 0, symbolName, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 1, "LONG ABOVE", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.green, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 1, f_display(le), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.green, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 2, "LONG STOP", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.orange, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 2, f_display(ls), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.orange, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 3, "LONG T1", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 3, f_display(lt1), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 4, "LONG T2", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 4, f_display(lt2), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 5, "SHORT BELOW", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.red, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 5, f_display(se), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.red, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 6, "SHORT STOP", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.fuchsia, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 6, f_display(ss), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.fuchsia, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 7, "SHORT T1", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 7, f_display(st1), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 8, "SHORT T2", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 8, f_display(st2), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 9, "RTH VWAP", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 9, f_display(rthVWAP), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 10, "PDH / PDL", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 10, f_display(pdh) + " / " + f_display(pdl), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 11, "STATUS", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 11, correctDate ? "DATE ACTIVE" : "PREVIEW / EXPIRED", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.black, text_size=size.tiny)
